attestation: migrate to generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro This CL replaces the uses of MOCK_METHOD*() and MOCK_CONST_METHOD*() macros in unit tests with the generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro, which is now the recommended way to define mocked methods with gmock. In particular, MOCK_METHOD() supports annotating a mocked method with specifiers such as 'override'. One minor change is that argument names are omitted in the argument list provided to MOCK_METHOD() in order to prevent clang-format from formatting code like `Foo* foo` into `Foo * foo`. tpm_manager: remove stale local data from the disk After TPM ownership is cleared, tpm manager local data becomes stale. If it's somehow not wiped after reboot/encstateful remount, the stale data will show up in TPM status (e.g., the output of `tpm_manager_client status`) and/or be reused by tpm manager again. This change detects and removes stale local data shortly after tpm_managerd starts. BUG=chromium:974313 TEST=Unit tests. On a soraka: 1. Take tpm ownership, define a new NV space, soft-clear tpm, restart tpm_managerd, run tpm_manager_client status, and make sure all the stale data is gone, including the nvram policy. 2. Following 1, define another new NV space, restart tpm_managerd, run tpm_manager_client status again, and make sure a policy of the new space is added. 3. Following 2, take ownership, restart tpm_managerd, and make sure the new local data isn't removed. 4. Manually modify trunks utility to fail after the endorsement password is set, soft-clear tpm, restart tpm_managerd, and take ownership. Make sure take ownership fails but local data contains the new passwords. Then, restart tpm_managerd and make sure nothing is wiped in the local data. On a chell: Do the same tests above by replacing soft-clearing tpm with backing up and restoring stale /var/lib/tpm_manager/local_tpm_data, simulating an unwiped encstateful. Change-Id: I351a82f1843f6e752c7b46433c80c2def4b14535 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1765808 Tested-by: Wei-Cheng Xiao <garryxiao@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Leo Lai <cylai@google.com>

bluetooth: Use dbus::ObjectPath type instead of string The properties "Device" and "Service" need to use dbus::ObjectPath type to be BlueZ-compliant. This requires changing *ToObjectPath converters to return dbus::ObjectPath type. Otherwise, wrongly using string type for "Device" and "Service" properties may cause clients to not recognize these properties. bluetooth: Add debug info on first failure of test functions Our test functionality is run with a _test_retry_and_log decorator that re-tries a function in case of failure. After the second failure, the test is marked as failed and the return value of the function is printed. However, the return value of the first run is equally, if not more important for debugging the cause of failure, so this patch prints out the return value of the first failure.
